{{Short description|Uniform tiling of the hyperbolic plane}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U443_01}}
In [[geometry]], the '''cantic order-4 hexagonal tiling''' is a [[Uniform tilings in hyperbolic plane|uniform]] tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,1</sub>{(4,4,3)} or h<sub>2</sub>{6,4}.
